data.body: Instrumentation change uploaded to Gerrit as change 2206 (patch set 1, commit dd9cbb63bf93). Added monotonic timing partitions across the close wrapper, completion attempt, handle resolution, and dispatch layers; updated the reusable duration probe to report the hierarchy and calculate unattributed verifier time only from non-overlapping wrapper partitions. Local full-suite execution was intentionally skipped/stopped at the operator's request due to limited resources; Gerrit CI run 32797199163 is the validation source.
